title: Thesis opening: how does the revision on pp. 5–6 read?
body:
The [revised introduction](https://joern-pc.tailc5e761.ts.net/files?project=msc-math-worktrees&path=opening-pass-2026-10-23%2Fthesis%2Fbuild%2Fmain.pdf&page=5) replaces the phrasing you rejected and revises the surrounding two-page opening. Result summaries were checked against the manuscript, and an independent reader checked prose and layout; this is not a new verification of the proofs or external papers.

Please grade the revised opening PASS/FAIL or 0–10, with any comments you find useful. This asks only about pp. 5–6; whole-thesis acceptance remains open.

[review: 01a16d56-b14f-7352-958b-085fc1de7a6a]
answer: i don't evne recognize the introduction as such? it starts with previous work, instead of motivating first that this thesis aims to give contributions to a field, especially around bringing in empirical methods and using AI?
